children.name: Degeneria roseiflora J.M.Mill.
children.description: A tree endemic to Fiji, one of two species of the primitive angiosperm genus Degeneria (sole genus of family Degeneriaceae, order Magnoliales). Described in 1988, it differs from D. vitiensis in its rose-pink-tinged flowers. Degeneria is notable for its unsealed laminar carpel and a broad, leaf-like stamen lacking a distinct filament and anther.

children.name: Degeneria vitiensis L.W.Bailey & A.C.Sm.
children.description: Degeneria vitiensis is a flowering tree found on Viti Levu in Fiji.
